description: Short real-run smoke for 05_jigsaw_puzzle: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. Like 09_jigsaw_puzzle_pp this keeps the default train.image_size (255): the 3x3 jigsaw grid of 75px tiles needs image_size >= 3*tile_size, so it cannot be shrunk to 64. The AlexNet/CFN encoder is light enough to run at the full resolution for one epoch.
